description: Scan a web page URL for accessibility issues and get a CSV report. For a mobile app, run it on App Automate with accessibility on (setupBrowserStackAppAutomateTests), then fetchAccessibilityIssues.

advancedRules.description: Run advanced rules (default true; off if the plan lacks them).

authConfigId.description: Auth config ID, for a page behind a login

experimentalRules.description: Run experimental rules (default true; off if the plan lacks them).

localIdentifier.description: ID of a BrowserStack Local tunnel you started, for localhost or internal URLs.

needsReview.description: Also report "needs review" issues to check by hand (default true).

pageURL.description: URL of the page to scan

scanId.description: Only to re-run an earlier scan of this same page (e.g. after a fix), with its saved settings, so runs can be compared.

name: startAccessibilityScan
